businesses.business: chlor alkali, epoxy and Winchester ammunition manufacturing

offering_description.value: Manufactures chlorine, caustic soda, vinyl and related chemicals, epoxy resins and intermediates, and sporting and military ammunition. Sells to industrial manufacturers, water treatment and chemical processors, distributors, retailers, and government customers. Produces at its own plants in the US and abroad.

primary_products.value: caustic soda; chlorine; epoxy resins; ethylene dichloride and vinyl intermediates; sporting and military ammunition

customer_segment.value: B2B: chemical processors, vinyl and epoxy producers, water treatment, pulp and paper, alumina, coatings and composites makers, distributors; B2C: hunters and sport shooters buying ammunition through retailers; B2G: US military and law enforcement agencies buying ammunition

end_markets.value: chemicals; water treatment; construction; pulp and paper; aerospace and coatings; sporting goods and defense

revenue_model.value: product sales: chemicals, epoxy materials and ammunition sold to industrial, retail and government buyers; project or contract: military and law enforcement ammunition contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: turns salt, electricity, ethylene, benzene, metals and propellants into chemicals, resins and ammunition; raw materials: chlorine, caustic soda and intermediates supplied to downstream chemical producers; brand owner: Winchester ammunition sold under its own brand to retail and government buyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; raw materials; brand owner

geography_served.value: global: US-centered production with sales across North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: chlor alkali products, epoxy and Winchester ammunition, chemicals share production processes, ammunition is separate

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: industrial chemical customers and government ammunition buyers; distributors / dealers: chemical distributors and ammunition distributors; third-party retail: sporting goods and outdoor retailers selling ammunition
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: hazardous chemicals under EPA, OSHA and DOT rules, ammunition under ATF and export controls

notes: Epoxy segment may have been restructured; details based on prior knowledge.
